about: Effect registry for compose-runtime/2 (research/blockers-20261021/ATTACK.md Move 2; MOVE2-COMP.md). One identity template per system.op: the logical effect a call makes (SPEC-E section 1, 'one key per logical effect'), built from entity arguments only, never from the caller's trigger, event or emission time. It mirrors experiments/compose/capabilities.mjs identityOf (the grader-side definition); runtime2.test.mjs checks the mirror, so identityOf is the test oracle, not the source. Two deliberate differences, both from the grader scoping identities per case while host keys are world-wide: (1) a notice about no entity (about null) has no identity here and keeps its caller's key; (2) more generally, a slot with no default whose argument is null or missing leaves the identity unresolved (the write keeps its caller's key, finding identity-unresolved), where identityOf spells the null ('charge:null'); a null-spelled identity would merge every fulfilment-less write of one op world-wide. Slot values are escaped so identities are injective: '%', ':' and '#' as %XX, a number as '#<n>' (1 and '1' differ), and a value spelled like its slot's default as '%=' + value (a fulfilment id '-' differs from a missing one); E8's identities contain none of these, so they equal identityOf's (runtime2.test.mjs checks both). Template syntax: {arg} needs a string or number; {arg|x} writes x when the argument is null or missing. batch: the template is filled per item over the batch arguments plus the item. read: a read-only op (no effect, never re-keyed, outside the single-writer gate). money: informational.
